display_information.name: Idle Realms
display_information.description: The Channel Crawler RPG — A story-driven cooperative adventure in Slack
display_information.long_description:
Idle Realms is a collaborative, story-driven RPG that lives entirely in Slack. Join a campaign channel, create your character, and embark on AI-powered adventures with your coworkers. Battle monsters, collect loot, equip gear, and shape the story through your choices — all without leaving Slack.

⚔️ Turn-based tactical combat via modals
📖 AI Dungeon Master narrates your adventure
🗺️ Explore dungeons and complete quests
🎒 Collect weapons, armor, and items
🤖 AI companion fights for you when you're busy
👥 Cooperative — play with your whole team

Perfect for team-building that doesn't feel forced.
